promoter: Title for the advertisement management interface special page
campaignad: Title for campaign management section or page
promoter-summary: Introduction text displayed at the top of the campaign management interface
promoter-manage: Button or link text to access campaign management interface
promoter-no-campaigns-exist: Message shown when no campaigns are available in the system
promoter-archive-show: Link text to display archived campaigns that are hidden by default
promoter-campaign-linked-to: Label indicating what the campaign is linked to
promoter-enabled: Label for enabled/disabled status of a campaign
promoter-archive-campaign: Button text to archive a campaign
promoter-add-campaign: Button or heading for adding a new campaign
promoter-null-string: Error message shown when attempting to add an empty value
promoter-campaign-exists: Error message shown when trying to add a campaign that already exists
promoter-campaign-doesnt-exist: Error message shown when attempting to access a non-existent campaign
promoter-archive-edit-prevented:
Error message explaining why a campaign cannot be edited. Parameters:
* $1 - (unused in current implementation)
promoter-no-assigned-cat: Message indicating an item is not linked to any category or page
promoter-no-ads: Message shown when no ads exist in the system
promoter-assigned-ads: Heading for the list of ads assigned to a campaign
promoter-no-ads-assigned: Message shown when a campaign has no ads assigned to it
promoter-add-ad: Button text to add a new ad to a campaign
promoter-add-new-ad-title: Title for the dialog/form to create a new ad
promoter-balanced: Checkbox label for giving equal weight/priority to all ads in a campaign
promoter-locked: Label indicating a campaign or ad is locked and cannot be edited
promoter-ads: Label or tab name for the ads section
promoter-campaigns: Label or tab name for the campaigns section
promoter-campaign-heading:
Heading for campaign detail page. Parameters:
* $1 - campaign name
promoter-available-ads: Heading for list of ads that can be added to a campaign
promoter-filter-ad-prompt: Placeholder or label for ad filter input field with example
promoter-filter-ad-submit: Button text to apply the ad filter
promoter-ad-already-linked: Error message when trying to link an ad that is already linked to a campaign
promoter-ad-already-exists:
Error message when trying to create an ad with a name that already exists. Parameters:
* $1 - ad name
promoter-ad-doesnt-exists:
Error message when attempting to access a non-existent ad. Parameters:
* $1 - ad name
promoter-add: Button text to add an item
promoter-all-except:
Option to select all items except specified ones. Parameters:
* $1 - items to exclude
promoter-manage-ads: Button or heading text for managing ads
promoter-remove: Button text to remove an item
promoter-preview: Button text to preview an ad
promoter-settings: Tab or section heading for settings
promoter-ad-display: Label for ad display targeting options
promoter-ad-anonymous: Option to display ad to anonymous (not logged in) users
promoter-ad-user: Option to display ad to logged in users
promoter-anon: Checkbox label to enable display to anonymous users
promoter-user: Checkbox label to enable display to logged in users
promoter-edit-ad: Button or heading text for editing an ad
promoter-ad-link: Label for the main link URL of the ad
promoter-ad-date-start: Label for the date when ad should start displaying
promoter-ad-date-end: Label for the date when ad should stop displaying
promoter-ad-inconsistent-dates-error: Error message shown when only one date field is filled (both or neither required)
promoter-ad-date-end-bigger-than-date-st: Error message shown when end date is earlier than start date
promoter-ad-active-label: Label for the active/inactive status field
promoter-ad-active: Checkbox label indicating the ad is currently active
promoter-ad-linked-campaigns: Heading for list of campaigns linked to this ad
promoter-ad-linked-campaigns-empty: Message shown when an ad is not linked to any campaigns (orphaned)
promoter-edit-ad-summary: Help text explaining how to create translatable message strings in ad content
promoter-edit-ad-magicwords:
Label for magic words section. Parameters:
* $1 - list of available magic words
promoter-insert:
Button text to insert an item. Parameters:
* $1 - item to insert
promoter-close-button: Label or tooltip for a close button
promoter-save-ad: Button text to save changes to an ad
promoter-clone: Button text to clone/duplicate an ad
promoter-archive-ad: Button text to archive an ad
promoter-delete-ad: Button text to delete an ad
promoter-clone-name: Label for name field when cloning an ad
promoter-add-ad-button: Button text to create a new ad
promoter-add-ad-cancel-button: Button text to cancel ad creation
promoter-ad-name-error: Error message shown when an invalid ad name is entered
promoter-delete-ad-title:
Confirmation dialog title for deleting ads. Parameters:
* $1 - number of ads to delete (for plural support)
promoter-delete-ad-confirm: Warning message in delete confirmation dialog
promoter-ad-still-bound:
Error message when trying to remove an ad that is still linked to a campaign. Parameters:
* $1 - ad name
promoter-clone-cancel: Button text to cancel cloning operation
